description: DM9 channel 9 modified PI profile from the scan taken while both mirrors were at nominal bit 2000. A constrained monotonic loading response is used because the low-bit region has a broad near-dead-zone with small non-monotonic measurement noise.

linearized_command.definition: A nominal bit maps linearly onto displacement; the compensator inverts the model to reach it.

limits.reference_definition: Displacement is zeroed when the home command applies the minimum bit.

calibration.method: Degree-10 Chebyshev loading curve plus 7 non-negative play operators, fitted by least squares over the measured drive order, with strictly increasing loading-response constraints, with an exact 1124.596300000 nm saturated-endpoint constraint.
calibration.displacement_reference: Each measurement run is zeroed at its first usable row.
calibration.endpoint_constraint_source: Maximum of the two repeated relative displacement_nm samples recorded at hardware bit 4095.
calibration.source_measurement_mode: Mx fixed-coordinate height with piston and tilt removed (mx_plane_removed=1), while both mirrors were moved to nominal bit 2000.
calibration.model_selection: Degree-10, seven-play-operator candidate selected after requiring a strictly increasing primary loading response on a 2048-point voltage grid.

dead_zone_characterization.interpretation: Near-dead-zone: low sensitivity rather than an exactly flat response after the monotonic fit.

known_limitations: The low-bit region is poorly conditioned: small height noise maps to large bit changes, so accurate sub-approximately-60-nm control cannot be established from this scan alone.
The exact PI saturated endpoint is 1124.596300 nm; the two repeated bit-4095 measurements differ by 0.279900 nm.
The fitted output is local fixed-point displacement relative to the Mx plane after piston and tilt removal, not absolute whole-mirror piston motion.
The measured return to bit 0 is not forced to zero; home/reset defines zero in the software model.
The fit uses bit and displacement_nm in acquisition order; mx_input_value is not used.
Hardware validation must use the same both-mirrors-at-2000 operating condition.
